title: Attribute Condition Queries without Code Evaluation
description: A TypeScript library for query builders of web maps and data catalogues: conditions on the fields of records (text, numbers, dates, yes/no) joined with AND and OR, evaluated as data without eval, read back as a sentence with brackets in English or Greek, checked with messages for the person, and carried in a URL.
